resources.string: Lets a program on your computer read the Computer desktop state and take screenshots. It listens on the phone only (127.0.0.1), not on Wi-Fi, and cannot run commands, click or type. Connect with adb forward.

On your computer run: adb forward tcp:%1$d tcp:%1$d
Then call http://127.0.0.1:%1$d/v1/computer/state
with the header: Authorization: Bearer %2$s
The API stops at %3$s.
